title: Ensure tree shaking is working
body:
If a user do this:

``` js
import {InstantSearch, RefinementList};

// only use RefinementList.connect
```

Then only the code of InstantSearch and RefinementList.connect should be inlined. I am not sure at all given our export API/design that this is the case.

This is linked to #1303

comments.body: Now that we did #1303 and #1454 there's no way tree shaking would not be working as expected. We are only doing named exports, there's no subnamespacing like Range.Rating
